groups.name: wow.cosid
groups.description: wow-cosid's settings, `wow.cosid.*`: the one default of each key, and the class its configuration metadata comes from. The module imports no Spring Boot, so WowCosIdAutoConfiguration reads its key from Spring's `Environment`, falling back to the default here; the host knows the key from the metadata this module ships.

properties.name: wow.cosid.global-generator
properties.description: The CosId generator of the node's global ids (command ids, wait ids), by its name in `cosid.generators`: CosId's `default` generator when not set. It must be one of CosId's generators, or the node does not start; a `cosid80` generator with a radix-62 codec gives 15-character ids that sort like their time.
